caption:
Free, quick, and most people skip it. ✅

Pull your credit reports from all three bureaus and read them line by line. Look for accounts you don't recognize, wrong balances, or old addresses.

The official free reports cost nothing, so never pay anyone for them.

When did you last check yours?
first_comment: Have you ever found an error on your report? 👇
